headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Milwaukee Brewers secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 11. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBI. The Brewers also dominated the Cardinals in a separate game, winning 10-2 behind Robert Gasser's 7.2 innings pitched.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip strain. Other injured players include Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates, David Hamilton of the Milwaukee Brewers, and Martín Pérez of the Atlanta Braves.

The New York Mets made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in exchange for cash. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a narrow win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski pitching 7.0 innings, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Brewers Blast Cardinals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers dominated the St. Louis Cardinals, securing a 10-2 victory. Robert Gasser led the Brewers' pitching effort, throwing 7.2 innings with 4 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Matthew Boyd earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall to Tigers in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics 6-2, securing a decisive victory. Colt Keith led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Buxton Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip strain, effective retroactive to July 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
